rationale: Exact prediction target variable ($y$). Cannot be used as feature.
Phase current is a direct electrical consequence of generated active power ($I \approx P / (\sqrt{3} V \cos\phi)$). Including current creates trivial circular leakage.
Grid voltage is primarily governed by the utility substation and grid stiffness rather than turbine power.
Direct power factor calculation derived from instantaneous active and apparent power.
Coupled to electrical generator inverter controls; excluded from primary aerodynamic power prediction.
Controller internal setpoint; kept for benchmarking against supervisory control, but primary ML model trains without it to remain independent of SCADA setpoint availability.
Operational status flag derived from wtc_ScTurSto_timeon; used only for data partitioning/filtering, not as a regression input.
Synthetic curtailment flag derived using power; using it as input would cause label leakage.
